basic_info.description: Deluxe studio in a serene park-like setting in the middle of San Francisco.  Surrounded by greeneries, residence 204K boasts an open living space with pleasant views of southern hills and the bay. Unusually spacious,  residence 204K is both functional and stylish: remodeled kitchen with breakfast bar, walk-in closet, intimate sleeping alcove and a gas-burning fireplace. Enjoy resort style amenities such as outdoor heated pool, fitness center, club house and seven wooded acres of trails, streams and gardens. Other amenities include secured garage parking, elevator and on-site management. Surprisingly affordable, residence 204K makes the perfect starter home or pied-a-terre.
